simple.meaning: שֶׁכֶן (sheken) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a residence.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Deuteronomy, beginning at Deuteronomy 12:5. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׁכֶן (H7933) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שֶׁכֶן (sheken) / H7933 is traced through Deuteronomy 12:5 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H7933. sheken [ שֵׁ֫כֶן ?] noun masculine dwelling ; — suffix שִׁכְנוֺ Deut 12:5 (compare שכן dwelling Ecclus 14:25), but see v Pi`el above

occurrences.englishText: But to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.
